class.name: OcgToptoolsShapeset
class.brief_description: A ShapeSets contains a Shape and all its sub-shapes and locations. It can be dump, write and read.
class.description: ! A ShapeSets contains a Shape and all its ! sub-shapes and locations. It can be dump, write ! and read. ! ! Methods to handle the geometry can be redefined.

method.name: TopTools_ShapeSet
method.description: Builds an empty ShapeSet.

method.name: SetFormatNb
method.description: Sets the TopTools_FormatVersion

method.name: FormatNb
method.description: Returns the TopTools_FormatVersion

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the content of the set. This method can be redefined.

method.name: Add
method.description: Stores <S> and its sub-shape. Returns the index of <S>. The method AddGeometry is called on each sub-shape.

method.name: Shape
method.description: Returns the sub-shape of index <I>.

method.name: Index
method.description: Returns the index of <S>.

method.name: Write_1
method.description: Writes the content of me on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: Read_1
method.description: Reads the content of me from the stream <IS>. me is first cleared.

method.name: Write_2
method.description: Writes on <OS> the shape <S>. Writes the orientation, the index of the TShape and the index of the Location.

method.name: Read_2
method.description: Reads from <IS> a shape and returns it in S.

method.name: AddGeometry
method.description: Stores the geometry of <S>.

method.name: DumpGeometry_1
method.description: Dumps the geometry of me on the stream <OS>.

method.name: WriteGeometry_1
method.description: Writes the geometry of me on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: ReadGeometry_1
method.description: Reads the geometry of me from the stream <IS>.

method.name: DumpGeometry_2
method.description: Dumps the geometry of <S> on the stream <OS>.

method.name: WriteGeometry_2
method.description: Writes the geometry of <S> on the stream <OS> in a format that can be read back by Read.

method.name: ReadGeometry_2
method.description: Reads the geometry of a shape of type <T> from the stream <IS> and returns it in <S>.

method.name: AddShapes
method.description: Inserts the shape <S2> in the shape <S1>. This method must be redefined to use the correct builder.

method.name: Check
method.description: This method is called after each new completed shape. <T> is the type. <S> is the shape. In this class it does nothing, but it gives the opportunity in derived classes to perform extra treatment on shapes.

method.name: NbShapes
method.description: Returns number of shapes read from file.
